description: August 28 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 1, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 28 birthday falls in Virgo, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: August 28 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Twenty-eight reduces to 1, adding independence to Virgo's careful mind on August 28th. Four degrees into the sign, Mercury sub-rules the decan as well as the sign, so thinking is sharp and fast. Traditional readings picture a self-reliant specialist who prefers to do things properly and personally. Delegating is often the skill worth practising.

On August 28 the Sun usually sits at about 4° Virgo, in the first decan, where Mercury rules the decan as well as the sign. Mercury rules Virgo and also governs its opening decan, from about August 23 to September 2. Doubled Mercury in an earth sign points towards analysis, method and a talent for noticing the detail everyone else walked past. People with these birthdays are often called helpful, articulate and quietly witty, with high standards for their own work. The flip side is a busy mind that can turn on itself, cataloguing flaws long after the job is done. Their best gift tends to be useful precision: making a system clearer, a text tighter or a routine kinder to the people who follow it.

sections.heading: August 28 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 28th reduces as 2 + 8 = 10, then 1 + 0 = 1. The birthday number is 1, but reached by a route that runs through partnership (2) and authority (8). Numerologists often read the 28th as a more cooperative kind of leader than the 1st: independent and ambitious, yet aware that big plans need allies. Those born on this day are frequently described as determined, enterprising and persuasive. As a supporting number, the 28 tends to show in a talent for starting things with others already on board, rather than recruiting help after the fact.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one August 28 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on August 28: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 28 is the 240th day of the year (241st in a leap year). By September 23, 26 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Libra.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by August 28, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on August 28 include José Eduardo dos Santos (1942), Jack Black (1969) and Shania Twain (1965).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 28?
faq.answer: August 28 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 28?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 28 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 28th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 28?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an August 28 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 28?
faq.answer: August 28 is also the birthday of José Eduardo dos Santos (1942), Jack Black (1969) and Shania Twain (1965). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
